chapter: Los Angeles 1947-48, Rock Island and bebop in New York
title: The Capitol Tower and his mother's list of Muskogee bands
summary: Chat about the Capitol Records building and his mother's help recalling bands.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Yeah, yeah. Mother asked me last night, she say that building that's circular. Circular out there that's King Cole and Frank Sinatra. What building is that? I say that's the building that Nat Cole and Frank Sinatra built, it's the Capitol Recording Studios. And office building.

Yeah. She says oh yeah. She says how did that come about? I say well they were the two stars for the label. And behind that they were able to make enough money to put up the towers. She say well, I never knew that before, she say I passed that place a many time and wondered what it was. (Laughter). Because I had her home boneing up trying to remember these two bands out of Muskogee that she had Coleman Hawkins' name down for me. Eppie Jackson out of Muskogee, I say well I'd forgot all of that. Well you do remember so and so and so. And I'd say I got that too and would add -- she would add a list for
me when I got home. Trying to help.
